title: RADIANT-Net revisited: code and data for a leakage-aware evaluation of multimodal deep learning for natural hazard type classification
description:
Code, data and supplementary material accompanying the manuscript RADIANT-Net revisited: a leakage-aware evaluation of multimodal deep learning for natural hazard type classification from environmental and catalogue data (submitted to Environmental Sciences Europe).

The repository contains: (1) the 500-event dataset (100 each of flood, cyclone, landslide, wildfire and earthquake) drawn from the GDACS, USGS ComCat and NOAA Storm Events catalogues; (2) the original data-assembly script and the feature-extraction script that re-derives 10 environmental features per event from ERA5 reanalysis (Open-Meteo historical archive) and the Copernicus GLO-90 elevation model; (3) the experiment script implementing RADIANT-Net v1, tuned tabular baselines and four leakage-aware evaluation protocols (repeated stratified splits, event-grouped CV, leave-region-out CV, temporal holdout), with statistical tests, stress tests and feature analyses; and (4) the analysis script that reproduces the tables and figures, plus Supplementary Tables S1-S2 and Figures S1-S2.
